children: Israel cybersecurity firm's Q3 revenue grew 16% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Q3 pretax profit missed analyst estimates
Growth driven by strong Security-as-a-Service revenue and recurring revenue gains
Allot raises 2026 revenue guidance midpoint, now sees $116 mln to $118 mln
Company expects 2026 SECaaS revenue growth to be above 40%
SECaaS GROWTH - SECaaS revenue rose 37% yr/yr and ARR increased 41% yr/yr, supporting recurring revenue base, per CEO Eyal Harari
SMART SOLUTIONS - Double-digit growth in SMART products attributed to conversion of high backlog into revenue after recent wins, per CEO Eyal Harari
CYBERSECURITY DEMAND - Rising demand for cybersecurity as threat actors use AI to target customers, supporting need for new solutions, per CEO Eyal Harari
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 6 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Allot Ltd is $13.90, about 55% above its November 11 closing price of $8.97
The stock recently traded at 24 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 22 three months ago
